title: nessie result record
description: One Result: one Nessus plugin's output for one Host, port and protocol. The base stream, lossless over the ReportItem. Draft (2026-11-23), schema version 1.

schema_version.description: Counted per kind. A reader refuses a version it doesn't know.

plugin_name.description: pluginName; changes between feed versions, never a key.

diff.description: Set by nessie diff only. The record is the new side for new and present, the old side for fixed and host-missing.

state.description: new: only in the new input. fixed: only in the old input, on a Host the new input has. present: in both. host-missing: only in the old input, on a Host absent from the new input.

changed.description: On present only: which members differ. plugin_output only when both sides have it.

host.description: A Host's identity as the scan gives it. Each member is present only when the scan has it; nessie computes no single identity.

name.description: ReportHost@name: an IP, an FQDN or an agent name.

scan.description: Which scan a record came from. Records read on stdin keep the scan member they arrived with.

file.description: The path as given on the command line, or - for stdin.

elements.description: Every ReportItem child element except plugin_output, keyed by its verbatim name (cm: prefix kept). Values are always arrays of trimmed strings: a repeated element appends, and the newline-joined cpe and see_also are split into items.

severity.description: Nessus's raw severity, 0-4. No name: Nessus 4.2 marks informational Results 1.

plugin_output.description: Verbatim, untrimmed. Present only under --output and when the Result has one. A Tenable VM truncation marker (***TRUNCATED***) stays in the text.
